# laravelforge_database (Resource)

Manages a database (schema) on a Laravel Forge server. Forge has no update endpoint for databases, so every input is replace-only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Database (schema) name. Create-only.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to create the database on.

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the database user. Only used when `user` is set. Create-only; not returned by the API.
- `user` (String) Optional database user to create alongside the database. Create-only; not returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the database.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
